title: Executions
description: Every run of every agent, live. Open one to follow its trace step by step.

empty.title: No executions yet
empty.body: Run an agent and its trace appears here, live.
empty.filteredBody: Widen the period or clear the filters.

detail.retried: Started again as a new execution
detail.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist or belongs to another workspace.

io.waiting: The answer appears here as soon as the model writes it.
io.truncated: The answer was cut by the output token limit.

timeline.title: Trace
timeline.description: What happened, in order. Internal events are kept apart from the agent's answer.
timeline.empty: Events appear here as the execution runs.
timeline.waitingWorker: Waiting for a worker to pick it up…

cost.partial: Some calls have no price: the total is a lower bound.

diagnosis.title: Why it failed
diagnosis.notRetryable: Retrying won't help until the cause is fixed

fallback.title: The execution failed
fallback.explanation: Gouvra recorded an error it doesn't explain in detail yet.
fallback.action: Check the trace below; share the execution ID if you need help.

provider_auth_error.title: The provider refused the API key
provider_auth_error.explanation: The key is wrong, revoked or belongs to another account.
provider_auth_error.action: Update the key in Providers, then run again.

provider_permission_denied.title: The key isn't allowed to use this model
provider_permission_denied.explanation: The provider account has no access to the requested model or feature.
provider_permission_denied.action: Choose another model, or enable it in the provider's console.

provider_rate_limited.title: The provider is limiting requests
provider_rate_limited.explanation: Too many requests reached the provider in a short time.
provider_rate_limited.action: Wait a moment and run again, or lower the workspace concurrency.

provider_quota_exhausted.title: The provider account is out of credit
provider_quota_exhausted.explanation: The provider refused the call because the balance or quota is used up.
provider_quota_exhausted.action: Top up the provider account, then run again.

provider_unavailable.title: The provider is unavailable
provider_unavailable.explanation: The provider's servers didn't answer normally (overload or outage).
provider_unavailable.action: Run again in a few minutes.

provider_timeout.title: The provider took too long
provider_timeout.action: Run again, or raise the agent's time limit.

provider_network_error.title: The provider couldn't be reached
provider_network_error.explanation: The connection failed before an answer came back.
provider_network_error.action: Check the base URL and the network, then run again.

provider_bad_request.title: The provider rejected the request
provider_bad_request.explanation: A parameter isn't supported by this model or provider.
provider_bad_request.action: Review the agent's model parameters, then run again.

model_not_found.title: This model doesn't exist at the provider
model_not_found.explanation: The model name is wrong or was retired.
model_not_found.action: Pick an available model in the agent's settings.

context_length_exceeded.title: The conversation is too long for the model
context_length_exceeded.explanation: Instructions, input and tool results exceed the model's context window.
context_length_exceeded.action: Shorten the input or instructions, or choose a model with a larger context.

content_filtered.title: The provider's safety filter blocked the answer
content_filtered.explanation: The provider declined to return content for this request.

provider_invalid_response.title: The provider sent an answer Gouvra couldn't read
provider_invalid_response.explanation: The response didn't follow the provider's documented format.
provider_invalid_response.action: Run again; if it persists, check the provider's status page.

provider_misconfigured.title: The provider is misconfigured
provider_misconfigured.explanation: Its settings are incomplete (missing key or base URL).

provider_missing.title: The agent has no provider
provider_missing.explanation: The provider was deleted or never chosen.
provider_missing.action: Choose a provider in the agent's settings.

agent_version_missing.title: The agent version is gone
agent_version_missing.explanation: The version this execution should run no longer exists.
agent_version_missing.action: Run the agent again from its page.

limit_exceeded.title: The agent hit one of its limits
limit_exceeded.explanation: Gouvra stopped it at the limit you set ({{limit}}).
limit_exceeded.action: Raise the limit in the agent's settings if the work genuinely needs more.

model_refused.title: The model declined the request
model_refused.explanation: The model chose not to answer this input.
model_refused.action: Rephrase the input or adjust the instructions.

output_truncated.title: The answer was cut off
output_truncated.explanation: The model reached its output token limit before finishing.
output_truncated.action: Raise max output tokens or ask for a shorter answer.

timeout.title: The execution ran out of time
timeout.explanation: It didn't finish within its time limit.
timeout.action: Raise the time limit or simplify the task.

worker_lost.title: The worker running it stopped
worker_lost.explanation: The process handling this execution disappeared (restart or crash).
worker_lost.action: Run it again: nothing was lost but the time spent.

worker_shutdown.title: Interrupted by a shutdown
worker_shutdown.explanation: The worker was stopped for maintenance before the execution finished.

internal_error.title: Gouvra hit an unexpected error
internal_error.explanation: The failure comes from Gouvra, not from the agent or provider.
internal_error.action: Run again; if it persists, share the execution ID with your administrator.

tools.tool_not_allowed: The model asked for a tool this agent may not use.
tools.invalid_arguments: The model sent arguments that don't match the tool's schema.
tools.tool_unavailable: The tool isn't available on this instance.

launch.title: Run {{agent}}
launch.description: The execution starts at once; you'll follow it live.
launch.inputTooLarge: The input is too large ({{max}} max).
launch.timeoutHelp: Defaults to the agent's limit ({{seconds}} s).
launch.costNote: Cost depends on the model's answer; it's shown live once known.
launch.rateLimited: Too many executions started in a short time. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
